name: Molyin
tagline: Every leading model. One studio. Video, images and music.
description: Molyin is an AI creation platform that curates the strongest video, image and music models into one studio: Seedance 2.5, Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, Nano Banana 2.1, GPT Image 2.5, FLUX.2, Suno 6 and Google Lyria 3. Make videos up to 4K with native audio, production-ready images and original songs, then use AI image and video tools for background removal, upscaling, restoration, subtitles and reframing. Free credits on sign-up; failed generations auto-refund.
